notes: IMPORTANT: the shared WebSearch budget ran out before any Pro-Tools-specific search could run, and pro-tools.com, jd2.com and roguefab.com all fail DNS for direct WebFetch here. Pro-Tools facts therefore come ONLY from the WRITER-KIT verified fact table (1/2-2" OD round, NPS 1/4-1-1/2 pipe, .134" max round wall, 2" x .134" 4130 with extension handle, 180 deg) and from docs/research/competitors-keywords-factcheck.md section 3.6, which itself was built from search-index summaries: square tube 1/2-1-1/2" (.065-.125 wall), 36" extension handle, min CLR about 3 x OD and max CLR 7", 180 deg 'after springback' on die pages, hydraulic package with 10-ton cylinder, and 105 Brute = 2-1/2" OD, NPS 2, 15-ton. Please re-verify all of these on pro-tools.com before publishing. JD2 facts come from WebSearch summaries of jd2.com pages run for the sibling article jd2-model-32-vs-rogue-fab-m605 (same caveat: summaries, not direct reads). Not verified and left out or softened: whether the hydraulic 105HD package has a wall rating above .134" (article says 'we found no rating above .134"'), what pump the Pro-Tools hydraulic package includes (article says 'check the package contents'), 105HD mounting/stand details, weights, warranties, and any separate 4130 rating for the JD2 Model 32 (article says none found). Cross-brand die fit is NOT claimed. A Rogue Fab comparison page claims the Pro-Tools 105 hydraulics are single-acting; left out as an unverified competitor claim. No prices used.
